Last night's change was supposed to add 6 security rules and 2 routes, but something's off and traffic is inconsistent. Reconcile the device to the intended design (attached).

Site notes: the firewall is `fw` (ssh fw). The intended design is /etc/nb/CHG-2211.md on fw.
Plan: nft add rule inet filter forward ip saddr 192.168.10.0/24 oifname eth2 tcp dport 443 accept; nft add rule inet filter forward ip saddr 192.168.10.0/24 ip daddr 192.168.30.10 tcp dport 80 accept; nft add rule inet filter forward ip saddr 192.168.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.1.0.0/16 log prefix '"CHG2211-R6 "' drop; ip route add 10.61.0.0/16 via 10.1.0.254
